businesses.business: content recommendation and native advertising platform

offering_description.value: Operates a content recommendation and native advertising platform that places sponsored article links and ads on publisher websites and apps, selling the placements to advertisers. Delivers campaigns through its own software, with publishers sharing in the ad revenue.

primary_products.value: content recommendation widgets; native ad units; advertising campaign software

primary_services.value: campaign management; audience targeting; performance analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands, advertising agencies, publishers and media websites

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and publishing; e-commerce; financial services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: advertisers pay for clicks or impressions on their native ads; commissions or management fees: net revenue retained after sharing ad income with publishers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: recommendation and ad-buying technology sold to advertisers and publishers; service provider: managed ad campaigns for brands and agencies, billed to advertisers

geography_served.value: global: Sells to advertisers and publishers across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line of content recommendation and native advertising technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large brands and publishers; online: self-serve platform for advertisers creating campaigns; partners / resellers: advertising agencies and demand partners buying placements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and advertising rules such as GDPR, CCPA and cookie consent requirements
